Madonna's "Don't Tell Me" reached #4 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Don't Tell Me" is a song recorded by American singer Madonna for her eighth studio album Music (2000).

The song peaked at #4 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 21 weeks on the chart.

Don't Tell Me was released in 2000.
